# TARA Sea Therapy

> Korean marine skincare made in South Korea with algae, spirulina, caviar and deep sea water. Featured in Vogue Korea, Allure Korea and Cosmopolitan Korea. Sold in the US on Amazon and TikTok Shop.

## Products

- [Algae Marine Toner: Korean Hydrating Toner with Sea Algae and Niacinamide](https://taraseatherapy.com/algae-marine-toner.html): TARA Algae Marine Toner is a Korean ampoule toner made with Icelandic glacial water, sea algae, niacinamide and Centella Asiatica. 150 ml, made in South Korea.
- [Algae Power Ampoule: Korean Seaweed Serum with Niacinamide and Ceramide](https://taraseatherapy.com/algae-power-ampoule.html): TARA Algae Power Ampoule is a concentrated Korean face serum with four seaweed extracts, niacinamide, ceramide NP and hyaluronate for dull, dehydrated-looking skin. 30 ml.
- [Spirulina Sheet Mask: TARA Algae Ampoule Sea Therapy Mask, Korean Hydrating Sheet Masks](https://taraseatherapy.com/algae-sea-therapy-mask.html): TARA's Korean sheet mask is soaked in a spirulina ampoule from marine algae with deep sea water, pearl extract and Centella Asiatica. 5 sheets, made in South Korea.
- [Algae Marine Lotion: Lightweight Korean Face Moisturizer with Sea Algae and Squalane](https://taraseatherapy.com/algae-marine-lotion.html): TARA Algae Marine Lotion is a weightless Korean emulsion with Icelandic glacial water, sea algae, niacinamide, squalane and trehalose for lasting hydration. 150 ml.
- [Black Caviar Power Eye Cream: Korean Eye Cream for Eyes and Neck](https://taraseatherapy.com/black-caviar-eyecream.html): TARA Black Caviar Power Eyecream is a Korean eye cream with caviar extract and Lactobacillus ferment for the eye area and neck. Lightweight, won't crease.
- [Caviar Power Cream: Korean Caviar Face Cream with Deep Sea Water](https://taraseatherapy.com/caviar-power-cream.html): TARA Caviar Power Cream is a rich Korean face cream with 150-hour fermented caviar oil, Hawaiian deep sea water and diamond powder for dry skin. 50 ml.
- [BHA Overnight Velvet Peel: Korean Exfoliating Pads with BHA, AHA and Marine Collagen](https://taraseatherapy.com/bha-overnight-velvet-peel.html): TARA BHA Overnight Velvet Peel: 12 pre-soaked cotton pads with BHA (5,000 ppm), AHA, marine collagen and hyaluronic acid for smoother-looking skin overnight. Featured in Allure Korea.

## Guides

- [Korean Skincare Routine Order, Step by Step](https://taraseatherapy.com/routine.html): The right order for a Korean skincare routine: toner, ampoule, sheet mask, lotion, eye cream and cream, plus how to fit in a BHA peel. Morning and night.
- [How to Use a Korean Sheet Mask for Dry Skin](https://taraseatherapy.com/sheet-mask-guide.html): A step-by-step guide to using a Korean sheet mask for dry, dull skin: when to use it in your routine, how long to leave it on, and what to do after.
- [How Often Should You Use a Sheet Mask? A Simple Weekly Guide](https://taraseatherapy.com/how-often-should-you-use-a-sheet-mask.html): How often should you use a sheet mask? A plain guide to weekly frequency, how long to leave it on, when it fits in your routine, and what to do after.
- [How to Use BHA Peel Pads at Night (Step by Step)](https://taraseatherapy.com/bha-peel-pads-guide.html): How to use BHA exfoliating peel pads: what BHA and AHA do, the right steps at night, how often to use them, and why sunscreen matters the next day.
- [Ampoule vs Serum vs Essence: What's the Difference in Korean Skincare?](https://taraseatherapy.com/ampoule-vs-serum-vs-essence.html): Ampoule vs serum vs essence in Korean skincare: how concentrated each one is, whether you need all three, the right order, and how to apply an ampoule.
- [Seaweed and Algae in Skincare: Spirulina, Wakame, Fucoidan Explained](https://taraseatherapy.com/seaweed-skincare-guide.html): A plain guide to marine skincare ingredients: spirulina, wakame (Undaria Pinnatifida), fucoidan, Ecklonia Cava, deep sea water, marine collagen and caviar.
- [Korean Skincare Guides](https://taraseatherapy.com/guides.html): Step-by-step Korean skincare guides: routine order, how to use a sheet mask, how to use BHA peel pads, and marine ingredients explained.
